name: Playable lead
description: An instrument rather than a control panel: the right hand plays notes from a pentatonic scale, the left hand shapes and swells them. Made for --synth.

mappings.name: Lead
mappings.comment: Right hand across the frame picks the note; raise it to play louder. Nothing sounds while the hand is out of frame.

mappings.name: Brightness
mappings.comment: Left hand height opens the filter — the expression pedal of this instrument.

mappings.name: Swell
mappings.comment: Pinch the left hand to fade out.

mappings.name: Vibrato
mappings.comment: Left peace sign adds a wobble.

mappings.name: Sustain Pedal
mappings.comment: Left fist holds notes so they stack into a chord.
